# Question 4

```{r}
set.seed(10)
n <- 100
U1 <- runif(n, 0, 1)  # Uniform (0,1)
U2 <- runif(n, 0, 1)  # Uniform (0,1)
U3 <- runif(n, 0, 1)  # Uniform (0,1)
U4 <- runif(n, 0, 1)  # Uniform (0,1)
U5 <- runif(n, 0, 1)  # Uniform (0,1)

Z1 <- sqrt(-2 * log(U1)) * cos(2 * pi * U2)  # Standard Normal
Z2 <- sqrt(-2 * log(U1)) * sin(2 * pi * U2)  # Standard Normal
Z3 <- sqrt(-2 * log(U3)) * cos(2 * pi * U4)
Z4 <- sqrt(-2 * log(U3)) * sin(2 * pi * U4)
Z5 <- sqrt(-2 * log(U5)) * cos(2 * pi * U1)

# Chi-Squared Distribution with 5 degrees of freedom
estimated_chi_values <- Z1^2 + Z2^2 + Z3^2 + Z4^2 + Z5^2
theoretical_chi_values <- rchisq(100, 5, ncp =0)

df1 <- data.frame(estimated = sort(estimated_chi_values, decreasing = TRUE), x = 1:100)
df2 <- data.frame(theoretical = sort(theoretical_chi_values, decreasing = TRUE), x = 1:100)

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = df1, aes(x=x, y = estimated),color="blue") +
  geom_point(data = df2, aes(x=x, y=theoretical), color= "red")
```
